description: DemaConsulting.CanvasNet.Scad renders models written in the OpenSCAD language: a clean-room lexer and parser with file/line/column diagnostics, a deterministic, resource-limited evaluator, and a geometry builder that turns the evaluated model into a CanvasNet.Render3D scene (ScadDocument.BuildScene) or draws it straight onto a CanvasNet Surface (ScadDocument.Render). Constructs that are not supported yet are reported, never silently skipped.
title: CanvasNet.Scad
